html: Research update: “Joint DOA and Attitude Sensing Based on Tri-Polarized Continuous Aperture Array” has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications.

Research update: “Spatial and Temporal Multi-Agent Interactive Localization: A Lightweight Personalized Federated Learning Approach” has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Communications.
Joined the Department of Electronic Engineering at Tsinghua University as a Postdoctoral Researcher, Shuimu Scholar and Zhang Keqian Named Postdoctoral Fellow.
Paper “DOA Estimation via Continuous Aperture Arrays: MUSIC and CRLB” published in IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications.
Conference paper “DOA Estimation for Tri-Polarized Continuous Aperture Array” appeared at IEEE ICC 2026.
Paper “Cross-Scenario Foundation Localization Models: Architecture, Key Technologies, and Challenges” published in IEEE Wireless Communications.
Paper “Unsupervised Localization Toward Crowdsourced Trajectory Data: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach” published in IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications.
Began a visiting Ph.D. research appointment at Queen Mary University of London, working with Prof. Yuanwei Liu and Dr. Jin Zhang.
